description: Keep an app files in sync with a GitHub repo. Each environment is a branch: `branch` is pre's, the source of truth for what is being worked on; `proBranch` (default "neblla-pro") is pro's, and only neblla_promote writes it, by merging the commit pre was last synced from (made on the first promote; a push to it changes nothing for the users). One nuance worth getting right: while linked, every file tool (neblla_upload_file, neblla_edit_file, neblla_delete_file, neblla_move_file) still works, and each call is a commit pushed to pre's branch of their repo with their token, then synced back, so an agent editing files lands commits on their branch, which is worth agreeing with them first. neblla_versions reads and restores that repo's pre and pro branches. A sync also DELETES files that disappeared from the repo, so old hashed build chunks do not pile up. Neblla runs no build step: the build output must be committed, because a gitignored dist/ syncs nothing. Mind the per-app file cap too (30 on free, 150 on Pro). Actions: "repos" — the developer GitHub repos (needs "Sign in with GitHub"); "branches" (url) — branches of a repo; "status"; "link" (url, optional branch, proBranch, subdir, syncMode auto (default) | manual, token only if the developer has not signed in with GitHub) — first sync, and in auto mode the push webhook is registered automatically when GitHub is linked; "sync" — pull now into pre (only changed files are downloaded); "set_mode" manual|auto; "commit" (files and/or deletes, optional message) — write files back to THEIR repo with THEIR token, as one commit, then pull the result back: several files in one commit (the file tools make one commit each). "unlink". A sync downloads only the files that changed, and its cost is not itemised in the quota table — so the case to watch is auto-sync on a large build, not the occasional manual pull.

appId.description: The app public ID (not needed for "repos" / "branches")

branch.description: For link: pre's branch, the one to follow (default: the repo default)

deletes.description: For "commit": paths to delete in the same commit

files.description: For "commit": the files to write, all in one commit

path.description: Path as the app knows it ("index.html"); the repo output folder is prepended

proBranch.description: For link: pro's branch, written only by neblla_promote (default "neblla-pro")

subdir.description: For link: folder inside the repo that holds the app (default "dist"; "" = repo root)

token.description: For link: GitHub token, only if the developer has not signed in with GitHub (stored encrypted, never returned)

name: neblla_git
